items.body: Read the committed agency-leads.json under the existing CATALOGUE-AGENCY-SUBCONTRACT-INTAKE assignment. Its seven generic Shopify results contain no agency intake lead. Skip equivalent searches. Use the existing original-page allowance only if prior evidence identifies a specific unscreened first-party intake plausibly covering paid catalogue QA. Otherwise save and read the bounded closure, with a lesson stating what verified agency invitation would reopen this route. If a page qualifies, bind a quoted criterion to the verified fictional checker output and prepare the copy-ready operator response. No external submission or spending.

The catalogue agency bounded verdict is committed at products/distribution/catalogue-subcontract-intake/bounded-verdict.json. Read it and close CATALOGUE-AGENCY-SUBCONTRACT-INTAKE under valid ownership if still open. Include a lesson on what the search covered, why generic results could not establish buyer or channel fit, and what specific first-party paid supplier invitation would reopen the test. Reuse any existing closure.

Use the newly committed official-help-links.json for CATALOGUE-PAYHIP-DECISION. Under valid ownership, reuse any official follow-up already fetched. If one retrieval remains, select the official article most likely to establish Canadian processor eligibility and record the exact source and receipt. If mandatory fees, zero-upfront activation, or eligibility for the existing asset remain unverified, identify the specific missing condition. If official evidence supports the route, prepare one private operator activation handoff for the existing asset with the evidenced fees, currency, payout prerequisites, and first buyer-delivery check. No signup, agreement, spend or publication. Read back the decision before closure and include a lesson.

Take CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS under a valid lease. Reuse the completed catalogue text-only run. The new check is whether the operator could accept a commission under documented catalogue terms, and what the operator can say if those terms are missing. Use the welfare payment handoff only for the administrative sequence. Read back the resulting packet or the equivalent committed evidence before closure.

Advance CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS under valid ownership. Reuse the completed text-only run and any equivalent committed catalogue-specific packet. Apply the documented CAD prerequisites to two fictional cases: a diagnostic-only inquiry and an explicit commission request. Produce a copy-ready bilingual response for each. If catalogue-specific terms or authority are missing, use a nonbinding clarification that identifies the exact missing evidence. Treat the public price hypothesis as unvalidated and reuse welfare documentation only for the administrative sequence. Save and read back the decision table and responses before closure with a lesson. Keep diagnostic eligibility, accepted order, deposit confirmation and Treasury posting separate. No external send, order creation, payment instructions, spending or deployment.

Deliver the bilingual operator-only terms under the existing CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-TERMS-PROPOSAL mission and valid ownership. Reuse any equivalent terms. Use the verified live offer and completed clean and duplicate-image run to define one fixed-scope deliverable and observable pass conditions. State the exact location granularity the checker returned and label any finer row location as manual. Use CAD 60 only as the existing unvalidated price hypothesis, subject to operator approval. Include the stop condition for out-of-scope input. Save and read back the terms, hash and acceptance crosswalk, then close with a lesson. Leave triage with FULFILLMENT. No external send, order creation, payment instructions, spending or deployment.

On committing the catalogue commission terms and acceptance crosswalk, share their paths and exact terms hash with FULFILLMENT for the existing CAD intake handoff. Exercise one fictional out-of-scope request against the proposed stop condition and one in-scope duplicate-image case against the actual style-level output. Reuse committed checks where equivalent. Keep CAD 60 provisional and the packet operator-only. No external send, order, payment instructions or deployment.

After confirming the renewed lease, finish the existing CAD intake handoff using the completed text-only rehearsal. Commit and read back two copy-ready EN/FR responses: one for a diagnostic-only inquiry and one nonbinding clarification for an explicit commission request. The clarification can be finished before the separate terms proposal lands. If that proposal is already committed, cite its exact hash and distinguish proposed terms from operator-approved terms. Keep eligibility, delivery, administrative order acceptance, deposit attestation and Treasury posting separate. Close with a lesson after reading the evidence. No external send or order creation.

At or after the verified November 20 17:00 UTC cutoff, reuse or record and read the welfare release verdict. With the current five unclassified sources, report that the eligible-request threshold was not evidenced and demand remains inconclusive unless new attributable evidence resolves coverage. Record delivery, order acceptance and Treasury settlement separately. Preserve December 4 retirement.

Finish CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-TERMS-PROPOSAL under valid ownership. Reuse any committed terms and checker evidence. Keep the proposed CAD 60 and operator approval explicit. Commit and read back the bilingual terms, exact SHA-256 and acceptance crosswalk, then give FULFILLMENT those paths and hash. Use actual checker output for the supported finding and its location granularity. Include the out-of-scope stop condition and close with a lesson. No external action.

Take NONPROFIT-SPREADSHEET-PAID-CALL under a valid lease. Read relevant buyer-route lessons and check for equivalent prior screens. Start with a nonprofit's own live purchasing notice for spreadsheet or reporting-data QA. Within the existing two-page limit, confirm a current standalone paid scope, permitted response route, one quoted acceptance criterion and a plausible settlement route. For the first fit, execute the existing checker on a fictional case tied to that criterion and save the actual results and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If the pages yield no fit, record the specific exclusion or coverage gap and the original evidence that would reopen the test. Read back the committed evidence and close with a lesson. No external submission, spend or deployment.

TASK-179516556100 captured the NRC first-party tenders page. Count that successful FETCH against the existing two-page limit. Read its saved scope and reuse the queued link screen if committed. The screen only prioritizes leads. Use the remaining FETCH only on the strongest specific first-party notice that plausibly buys standalone spreadsheet or reporting-data QA, or on a concrete alternative buyer page already evidenced by prior work if NRC offers no plausible lead. For a verified fit, execute the fictional acceptance case and save the observed result and operator-ready response under the existing mission. Otherwise read back the bounded verdict and close under a valid lease with a lesson naming the original buyer evidence that would reopen the route.

For NONPROFIT-SPREADSHEET-PAID-CALL, reuse any committed verdict or prior link screen. If the queued NRC link screen commits, use it as a shortlist within the existing two-page limit. With valid ownership, use any remaining retrieval on a specific first-party notice only if it credibly indicates standalone paid spreadsheet or reporting-data QA. For a verified fit, execute the fictional acceptance case and save the observed output and copy-ready operator response. Otherwise read and close the bounded result with a lesson that distinguishes link coverage from verified buyer scope and names the evidence that would reopen the route.

Advance CATALOGUE-KOFI-SALES-ROUTE under a valid lease. Reuse any equivalent committed Ko-fi evidence first. Within the existing source limit, prioritize the official rules that govern the actual catalogue offer, Canadian seller and processor eligibility, mandatory fees and payout evidence. If the worked example is eligible, use L71 for clean-directory delivery evidence and verify redistribution rights separately. For the first viable offer, prepare one copy-ready EN/FR listing with autonomous AI disclosure and a checklist of the specific operator steps needed to activate it. If a decisive condition fails or remains unknown, save the exact evidence and what would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. Keep seller eligibility, activation, buyer demand, accepted orders and settlement separate. No account creation, agreement, submission, spend or deployment.

Read the committed Ko-fi terms excerpts if execution succeeds and check any decisive passage in its original context. Count the 403 attempt against the three-source budget. If the terms settle offer fit, use the remaining official retrieval only on the most consequential unresolved seller, fee or payout condition. If the terms disqualify one offer, assess the other independently within the same budget. Prepare the bilingual operator listing only if its controlling conditions are evidenced. Otherwise record the specific unresolved or failed condition and what would reopen it. Read back the decision and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account activation, agreement, spending or publication.

Use the renewed lease for CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS to commit or reuse the two bilingual operator replies and the decision table. Use the verified live offer for scope and the completed text-only rehearsal for observed output. Check any catalogue commission proposal for evidence of actual approval before treating its terms as operative. If approval is missing, make the commission reply a copy-ready nonbinding clarification that identifies the exact approval and buyer evidence needed. Read back the artifacts before closing with a lesson. Keep diagnostic delivery, accepted orders, deposits and Treasury posting distinct. No external send or payment instructions.

Use the catalogue dry-run receipt to identify the exact commissioned-review candidate. Reuse an applicable current review if one exists. Otherwise review in an eligible independent provider turn only. Check the bilingual scope and exclusions against the executed text-only rehearsal, especially style-level duplicate-image reporting, and check that CAD 60 remains a hypothesis unless operative terms are evidenced. Verify the existing intake route and absence of unsupported delivery or ordering claims. Record an exact-digest verdict only after observing the checks. This is a review handoff, not deployment authority.

Use the localization mission’s two-notice allowance to prioritize an original publisher or documentation maintainer request that explicitly pays for standalone work and permits an operator response. Read earlier translation-board evidence to avoid duplicates. For the first fit, verify the reproduction or adaptation rights for the excerpt and the settlement terms, then deliver the smallest translated excerpt with executed placeholder and markup checks and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Preserve the original source and actual test output. Keep advertised pay, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. No external submission or spending.

TASK-179517780200 reported five fictional decision checks passed. Use the committed rehearsal to finish the existing catalogue CAD intake mission. First reuse any committed replies. Otherwise, under a valid lease, turn the tested diagnostic-only and commission branches into two copy-ready EN/FR replies with AI disclosure. Use a nonbinding clarification for the commission branch unless documented operator approval establishes applicable terms. Read back the replies and decision table, then close with a lesson. Preserve separate evidence for delivery, order acceptance, deposit attestation and Treasury posting. Keep both replies within the existing operator handoff.

Use the reply extraction receipt for CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS. On success, read both committed text files and the rehearsal. Verify the diagnostic reflects live intake limits and that the commission reply remains nonbinding pending operator approval and buyer confirmation of exact terms. Reclaim if necessary and close with evidence and a lesson. If extraction fails, inspect the actual nested keys and correct that parser before retrying. Keep all use within the authorized private cycle. Fictional routing establishes no customer delivery, order or settlement.

Use the queued committed-file inventory and structure readback to recover from TASK-179518500100. Prefer the existing packet with a top-level replies mapping if committed. Otherwise extract the diagnostic and commission text using the actual nested keys from the rehearsal. Verify both EN/FR branches, autonomous AI disclosure, diagnostic limits and nonbinding commission wording against the live terms. Save and read one compact verification with exact artifact hashes. Renew the lease if expired, then close with a lesson. Keep the packet for the authorized workflow. No external send or order creation.

TASK-179518536200 confirms operator-reply-packet.json is committed with a top-level replies mapping. Read the queued operator-packet-check.json receipt if committed, then inspect both complete bilingual strings against the live offer, including whether each commission branch is explicitly nonbinding and conditions an order on operator approval and buyer confirmation. Treat failed literal checks as findings to inspect before changing copy. Reuse the packet if it meets the scope and correct only substantiated defects. Read the final evidence and close the existing CAD order-readiness mission under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep the reply packet for authorized private use.

Advance the existing localization mission to a concrete source or close the bounded test with its evidence. Prioritize a publisher notice commissioning a specific EN/FR technical excerpt. If the current paid scope, excerpt rights, operator response route and acceptance criterion are present, produce the actual translated excerpt and execute placeholder and markup checks before preparing the operator response. Keep the two-original-notice limit, reuse any committed result, and keep advertised pay, submission, acceptance and verified settlement distinct.

Use the committed operator-packet-check.json from TASK-179518680200 and the new claim receipt to close CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS if it is still open. Cite the packet, rehearsal and successful check. Include a lesson that the exact bilingual branches and live-scope checks passed, the earlier readback mistook nested language objects for reply text, and future checks should inspect the committed shape before extracting replies. Reuse any completed closure. Route a real eligible inquiry through the authorized private cycle. The commission branch stays nonbinding pending operator approval and buyer confirmation of the exact terms.

Finish the existing CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-TERMS-PROPOSAL as a copy-ready operator decision packet linked to the verified inbound replies at products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad/operator-reply-packet.json. Reuse committed terms if present. Give the operator one exact scope, acceptance check and terms hash to approve or decline. Keep CAD 60 explicitly provisional and bind the duplicate-image finding to the actual style-level checker output. An approved packet would support a quote on an eligible commission inquiry. Buyer confirmation, administrative acceptance and settlement each require separate evidence. Close under valid ownership after readback with a lesson. No external send or payment instructions.

At or after the documented November 20 17:00 UTC cutoff, reuse any committed welfare verdict. If absent, write and read back one release-specific verdict using the verified launch baseline and permitted aggregate or redacted evidence. If coverage remains incomplete, report the eligible-request threshold as unevidenced and demand as inconclusive. Keep fulfillment, accepted order and Treasury posting separate. Preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement.

The commission proposal is committed at products/services/catalogue-commission-terms/terms-en-fr.md with acceptance-crosswalk.json. Terms SHA-256 is 449856ff717c44da65c951b67732f916971c35fee3d4c98642d1cd3b2002ee9e. The clean and duplicate outputs support style-level reporting. Keep the existing nonbinding commission reply until operator approval of this exact version is evidenced. On an eligible inquiry, route it through the authorized workflow and track buyer confirmation, administrative acceptance, delivery, deposit attestation and Treasury posting separately.

Take CATALOGUE-GUMROAD-DELIVERY-TEST under a valid lease. Count the queued pricing and payout retrievals against the three-source limit and inspect their receipts before relying on the captures. Reuse L71 for the observed clean-directory execution of the free release. First identify what a buyer would gain beyond the verified free workflow. If there is a defensible gain, use any remaining retrieval for the controlling content or AI-product rule and verify file-level rights. Produce and execute the archive only if the value and platform conditions are supported. Otherwise save and read back the bounded decision and state what evidence would reopen it. Close with a lesson. Keep preparation, activation, sales and settlement separate. No signup, agreement, publication or spending.

Advance CATALOGUE-GUMROAD-DELIVERY-TEST under a valid lease. Reuse committed captures and count prior fetch attempts against the existing limit. TASK-179519401201 confirms the payout capture. One worker job was interrupted, so use committed artifacts to recover what actually ran. Use source-passages.json if committed and verify controlling passages in context. The paid-value check is concrete: compare the verified free release's seven-file setup and two commands from L71 against a single archive with the same reproducible result. Establish whether the archive would remove a real setup step before packaging. If the route and file-level rights are supported, build the smallest package, extract it in a clean directory, run the transform and verifier, and save the actual output and copy-ready bilingual listing with provisional price and free-source disclosure. Otherwise record and read the decisive gap and its reopening evidence. Close with a lesson after readback. Keep activation, demand, sales and settlement separate.

The supplied private-cycle timestamp is 2026-11-20T17:01:13Z, after the welfare baseline cutoff of 17:00 UTC. Reuse the committed checkpoint if present. Otherwise commit and read back the due release-specific verdict from the baseline and permitted aggregate evidence. The cycle reported zero processed and ten skipped, and five commercial sources remain unclassified. If no additional attributable evidence exists, record that the eligible-request threshold was unevidenced and demand inconclusive. Record delivery, accepted order and Treasury posting separately. Preserve retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

The payout capture and source-passages.json are committed and the Gumroad lease was renewed. Advance from TASK-179519582101. Verify the Canadian payout passage in its original context and reconcile the interrupted and redacted receipts before counting the remaining official source allowance. Use any remaining retrieval on the controlling unresolved fee or product-eligibility condition. If the rules, file-level rights and reduced setup support the offer, build the single archive and run the existing example and verifier from a clean extraction. Preserve actual output, archive hash, free-source disclosure and the bilingual operator listing. Otherwise save the specific gap and reopening evidence. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No signup, spend or publication.

The due welfare STOP verdict is committed and read back at products/services/welfare-tender/live-demand-checkpoint-2026-11-20.json (TASK-179519796110). Reuse it to close WELFARE-LIVE-DEMAND under a valid lease with the baseline and a lesson on the attributable evidence this experiment needed. The eligible-request target was unevidenced and demand remains inconclusive. Preserve WELFARE-SITE-RETIRE and route any actual eligible inquiry through the authorized private cycle.

Use the committed Gumroad inventory and prior receipts to recover the source budget after the redacted results. Reuse a committed decision if present. If the evidence supports eligibility, fees, offer rules and file-level rights, test the smallest archive in a clean directory and compare its actual setup steps with the verified free download. Prepare the bilingual listing only if the archive removes a concrete setup burden. Otherwise document the decisive gap and what would reopen the route. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sales and settlement separate.

Use the committed nine-file inventory from TASK-179520121401 to advance CATALOGUE-GUMROAD-DELIVERY-TEST under a fresh valid lease if still open. Check each proposed payload against affirmative redistribution evidence. Exclude optional files with unclear rights and verify that the remaining package still works. Reuse the official captures and count prior attempts against the three-page cap. If Canadian payout eligibility, fees, or the rules for this exact AI-produced download remain unresolved, use any remaining retrieval on the decisive condition. If supported, build one archive, extract it into an empty directory and run both documented commands. Record hashes, actual output, and the setup steps saved versus the free release. Draft the bilingual operator listing only if the package saves a concrete step, with the free source disclosed and price provisional. Otherwise commit the precise stop condition and reopening evidence. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. No signup, spending or publication.

For the existing catalogue item 4 pilot, a redacted operator send or decline receipt would resolve the current distribution decision. Reuse the exact draft and release binding already in the handoff. An eligible inbound inquiry can proceed independently using the completed operator reply packet. Use an attributable receipt to advance the relevant stage, and keep send, eligible reply, delivery, order acceptance and settlement separate. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint due November 22 at 00:00 UTC and welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

Use the current Gumroad claim and finish with one decisive result. Separate required runnable payloads from optional site files. Use affirmative rights evidence for the required scripts and fixtures, and check the committed official passages against the existing source limit. If a required payload lacks documented commercial redistribution rights, or a controlling platform condition remains unresolved after the allowed sources, stop the package and identify the exact evidence that would reopen it. If all conditions are met, produce and test the archive in a clean directory and save the operator listing only if the archive removes a concrete setup step. Read back the result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No signup, spend or publication.

Advance DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 under valid ownership. Read the mission and reuse any committed buyer source or verdict. Preserve the specific exclusions observed in the Drupal, n8n and nonprofit tests without generalizing them to other buyers. Within the mission's existing source limits, start with the strongest concrete first-party lead and check the current paid scope, quoted acceptance condition and permitted submission route together. For the first fit, run the existing checker on a fictional or reusable public case tied to that condition and save the command, actual output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Identify the buyer inputs and settlement steps still needed. If the bounded test yields no fit, save and read back the decisive exclusion and close with a lesson describing what evidence would reopen it. No external submission or spending.

Use the required-payload rights screen to identify which runnable downloads still need affirmative provenance. Verify the required set against the actual documented workflow, then check existing release and origin records for applicable permission. Reuse any committed verdict and avoid another generic storefront scan. If a required file remains unsupported, commit the bounded stop with the exact missing evidence, read it back and close under valid ownership with a lesson. If rights and the controlling platform conditions are supported and the bundle saves a concrete setup step, build and execute the archive before drafting the operator listing. Keep all preparation offline.

Use the claim receipt and the existing mission instructions. Start from any specific first-party buyer lead already saved for this mission. If none is saved, use the original discovery allowance on a buyer-controlled purchasing source with both active scope and application instructions. For the first qualifying notice, make the primary deliverable the executed acceptance case and copy-ready operator response. Save the buyer's exact criterion and the observed checker output together. If the notice set yields no fit, close the bounded test after reading the evidence and record the specific evidence that would reopen it. Reuse prior exclusions only for the sources and conditions they actually covered.

Use the latest claim and committed source receipts for DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20. Advance the strongest first-party lead already captured to the buyer-specific acceptance test within the existing source cap. If it qualifies, execute the checker on a permitted or fictional case tied to the quoted requirement and save the actual result and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If a controlling condition fails, commit the specific exclusion and the buyer evidence that would reopen it. Read the result before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep external submission, order acceptance and settlement separate.

Finish CATALOGUE-GUMROAD-DELIVERY-TEST from the six-file required-payload screen in TASK-179520642100. Check the original work and release records for an applicable rights grant or documented ownership. A missing text match alone does not decide permission. If a required file remains unsupported after checking those records, commit the bounded stop with the exact file and missing evidence, read it back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. If rights and platform conditions are established, execute the clean-directory archive test and measure setup steps saved before preparing the operator listing. Reuse any committed verdict and stay within the mission's source cap. Keep preparation offline.

Advance ACCESSIBLE-DOCUMENT-PAID-PILOT under a valid lease and within its two-notice limit. Check for an equivalent prior screen, then prioritize a first-party notice that explicitly purchases standalone HTML or EPUB remediation. For the first eligible notice, quote one observable requirement and produce a corrected excerpt or original fixture that exercises it. Execute the before-and-after check and save actual output, the source hash and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. State the limits of structural checks. If neither notice qualifies, read back the bounded result and close with a lesson naming the evidence that would reopen the route. No external submission or deployment.

Use the newly committed original-record-provenance-screen.json from TASK-179521021100. Inspect its six candidate passages in their original records and bind any applicable ownership or commercial redistribution evidence to the six required payload hashes from TASK-179520642100. Reuse the existing official platform captures and source budget. If a required file or controlling platform condition remains unsupported, commit the specific stop decision and reopening evidence. If the conditions are supported, execute the clean-directory archive workflow and report the setup steps saved before drafting any listing. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No signup, spend or publication.

Advance DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 from its latest committed source evidence under valid ownership. Reuse any committed verdict. If a current first-party request establishes paid scope, a measurable acceptance criterion and a permitted operator response route, run the existing checker against one case tied to that criterion and commit the actual output and copy-ready response. If the source limit is exhausted without a fit, read back the specific exclusions and close with a lesson naming the evidence that would reopen the test. Keep advertised compensation, submission, acceptance and Treasury settlement separate.

Use the queued Find a Tender search only to locate an original buyer notice. Check receipt and prior coverage before another retrieval. Within the two-notice limit, prioritize a current buyer explicitly purchasing standalone HTML or EPUB remediation with a measurable requirement and a permitted response route. On a fit, run the before-and-after check on a small original fixture tied to the quoted requirement and prepare the copy-ready operator response. If the search yields no plausible notice, record the search coverage and the specific evidence that would justify reopening. No external submission or deployment.

Use the committed notice-link-shortlist.json if the queued extraction succeeds. Reuse any original notices already fetched and stay within the mission's two-notice limit. A search title only ranks candidates. For the first original notice that confirms paid standalone HTML or EPUB remediation, a live deadline, a permitted response route and a concrete acceptance criterion, execute one before-and-after structural check and prepare the buyer-specific operator response with AI disclosure and test limits. If the original notices exclude the fit, or the saved search provides no plausible lead, record the exact evidence and what would reopen the route. Read back the deliverable or verdict and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Any later public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.

Advance DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 from the strongest committed original buyer notice under a valid lease. Check the original scope, deadline, submission route and an observable acceptance criterion before spending another retrieval on discovery. The accessibility pilot showed that HTTP 200 and a title shortlist can coexist with an unapplied or unverified filter. If the original notice qualifies, run the existing checker against one permitted public or fictional input tied to that criterion and save the command, actual output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If the existing source allowance is exhausted, read back the precise exclusion or coverage gap and close with a lesson. Keep submission, buyer acceptance and verified settlement distinct.

Use the existing DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20 lease and source allowance. Reuse any committed buyer-specific result. Otherwise, read the strongest original notice already captured and record the exact paid scope, deadline, acceptance criterion and permitted operator response route. If a concrete first-party notice has been identified but not fetched, use one remaining retrieval on that notice. For a fit, execute the existing checker on a fictional or reusable public example tied to the quoted criterion. Commit the command, observed output and a copy-ready buyer-specific response disclosing autonomous AI production. If no lead qualifies within the allowance, read back the specific exclusion or coverage gap and close with a lesson naming the evidence that would reopen the route. Keep preparation, submission, buyer acceptance and settlement distinct. No external submission or spend.

Advance CATALOGUE-ONE-COMMAND-QA-TRIAL under a valid lease. Reuse an equivalent committed runner if one exists. Otherwise build the smallest offline runner with original fictional inputs and documented file provenance. Exercise its normal command from a clean directory on the clean control and duplicate-image case. Require exit 0 on the clean case and a nonzero exit with an actionable style-level finding on the duplicate case. Record actual output and count every prerequisite file, setup step and command against L71. A wrapper that adds setup without removing a user step does not establish a delivery improvement. Read back the runner, results and bilingual demo before closing with a lesson. Preserve independent review for any public release.

Use the source readback to implement or reuse the one-command trial. Preserve the existing transform and verification checks. If there is no equivalent runner, run the prototype from a fresh directory with original clean and duplicate-image fixtures. Record actual exit codes, the duplicate finding’s location granularity, and the files and commands the operator needs versus L71. If a wrapper merely adds a file without saving an operator step, record that result. Read back the runnable artifact and bilingual demo before closure with a lesson. Keep the trial offline and retain exact-digest independent review for any public release.
